text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Sizzle, sizzle, my yummy veggie
stir-fry. ♪ Then
plop it on a nice big pile
of steaming rice! ♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Down goes the miso soup with a big, big
gulp. ♪
Guuulp...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Uh, what comes next again? Gulp,
aaand...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Why can't I remember?! And after I went
to all the
effort of making this lunch set
song!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ughhh, now it's gonna drive me nuts!
Does
anyone know the rest of the
words?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unable to remember the lyrics,

Matikanetannhauser is left restless and

unsatisfied.
